whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fit India Gym,

I noticed your gym has exceptional 4.8★ reviews with 140+ happy members in Kadamkuan, Patna, but your digital experience could be optimized for instant mobile trial bookings.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek high-converting custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, personal training programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fitindia

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Fit India Gym) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your Kadamkuan location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
